memory: I've always been captivated by the thrill of discovering new destinations, and that's something I've tried to do whenever my schedule allows. Since I'm a fourth-year Computer Science major, I have to be pretty strategic about planning my trips—between classes, research, campus clubs, and even everyday stuff like heading to the gym or working on group projects, my calendar gets ridiculously cramped. But I've managed to squeeze in some adventures that have given me some of my favorite memories so far.
